idempotencyNote: D-M1 owns no seed data, so no seed/migration is implied by this matrix. The conformance run is READ-ONLY (only this matrix artifact was written). Any future submission-related migration must remain ADDITIVE/idempotent (add-if-not-exists, guarded DO) and writing_submissions immutability (insert-only RLS) must be preserved — never drop/reset/truncate.
overallVerdict: All CONFIRMED D-M1 screen data requirements are SATISFIED by the LIVE schema (writing_drafts read for the summary, submit_writing_with_feedback RPC + writing_submissions for the confirmed submission, study_events for telemetry). The '모달 경고 문구' item LABELED '스키마 보강 필요' is correctly resolved per CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL to app/i18n copy (its 메모 says '현재는 앱 문구 계약이다', no DB query need) — NOT a schema gap. The ONE genuine open item is the '제출 동의 이력' persistence decision (screen-data-summary 검수 필요): flagged as a user-facing schema-gap / pending product decision, NOT escalated to unresolved (it is not admin/frozen and not a net-new feature to build now), and stableQueryNeed=false since no current render depends on it. No frozen-island objects touched.
